## TL;DR
Review pass 9 was good to go for the in-scope macOS Hub build, launch, discovery, and connection checks. No code changes are needed. Signed-in Projects and Tasks remain assigned to human follow-up #1174 and are not claimed as verified.

## Work and rationale
The QA record documents the checked native Hub flows and the fixes for test-host registry isolation and XCTest scratch cleanup. The latest review found no bugs and states that the signed-in screens are out of scope pending #1174. The branch is clean at the current tree.

## Approaches tried
Automated email-code entry did not reach the signed-in web UI. The updated task requirements track that verification in human task #1174. The QA record continues to identify those screens as unverified until the human result is recorded.

## Challenges and blockers
The remaining signed-in check requires the normal email-code flow and human observation. #1174 is still human-assigned with no results. The last `repoos check` passed on this tree, including build, the test suite, UI smoke, rendered contrast, and macOS Hub icon transparency.

## Key learnings
RepoOS consumes the engineering report draft during handoff finalization. Each handoff attempt needs a fresh draft with these required sections, even after a good-to-go review when no implementation changes are needed.
